Extraction._aiModelNote: AiModel is the Azure OpenAI deployment name, not the model name. Deployment 'nornis-extract' -> model gpt-5.4 (snapshot 2026-03-05). The ModelPricing key MUST match AiModel or cost tracking silently records $0. Rates per 1M tokens (verify against your resource's pricing blade): input $2.50 / output $15.00.

ServiceBus._lockRenewalNote: Renewal ceilings, not fixed costs — a run releases its lock when it finishes. Extraction is bounded by AiTimeoutSeconds x (1 + MaxParseRetryAttempts); library indexing is dozens of serial embedding calls over a whole PDF and needs far more headroom, or the lock lapses mid-run and Service Bus delivers a second, parallel run that re-buys every embedding. Each of those calls is now bounded by Library:AiTimeoutSeconds (default 60) — before that it was bounded only by the SDK's own worst case, so no ceiling here was large enough to be safe.
